## Summary
Build the coverage heatmap UI as an organism component that renders an 18x6 grid (USMLE systems x Bloom levels) with 3-state color coding (declared/delivered/confirmed), powered by the heatmap API from E06-S01.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to visually scan a color-coded heatmap of my course coverage, so that I can instantly spot which USMLE system + Bloom level combinations have gaps before I build an exam.

## Why this matters
A raw data table of 108 cells is unusable for decision-making. The heatmap turns coverage data into a scannable visual that lets faculty identify gap clusters in seconds. Without it, faculty must manually cross-reference spreadsheets, leading to blind spots in exam coverage that violate LCME standards.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] CoverageHeatmapGrid renders 18 rows (systems) x 6 columns (Bloom 1-6) grid
- [ ] Each cell is color-coded: gray = none, yellow = declared, blue = delivered, green = confirmed
- [ ] Cell opacity scales with coverage_score (0.0-1.0) for confirmed cells
- [ ] Hovering a cell shows tooltip: system name, Bloom label, item count, coverage score
- [ ] Summary bar shows total coverage percentage and counts per state
- [ ] Grid is responsive: horizontal scroll on mobile, full grid on desktop
- [ ] Loading state shows skeleton grid (18x6 placeholder cells)
- [ ] Error state shows error message with retry button
- [ ] CoverageHeatmapContainer fetches data and passes to CoverageHeatmapGrid (container/presenter split)

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/coverage-blueprint/hooks/useCoverageHeatmap.ts
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { createBrowserClient } from '@journey/db/browser'
import type { HeatmapResponse } from '../types'

export function useCoverageHeatmap(courseId: string) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<HeatmapResponse | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const fetchHeatmap = async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/coverage/heatmap?course_id=${courseId}`)
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`)
      const json = await res.json()
      setData(json.data)
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to load coverage data')
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => { fetchHeatmap() }, [courseId])
  return { data, loading, error, refetch: fetchHeatmap }
}

// features/coverage-blueprint/components/CoverageHeatmapGrid.tsx
// Presenter — receives data as props, zero data fetching
import type { HeatmapCell } from '../types'

interface CoverageHeatmapGridProps {
  matrix: HeatmapCell[]
  summary: { total_cells: number; covered: number; coverage_pct: number }
}

export function CoverageHeatmapGrid({ matrix, summary }: CoverageHeatmapGridProps) {
  // Pure render — grid cells with color coding
}

// features/coverage-blueprint/components/CoverageHeatmapContainer.tsx
// Container — fetches data, passes to presenter
'use client'
import { useCoverageHeatmap } from '../hooks/useCoverageHeatmap'
import { CoverageHeatmapGrid } from './CoverageHeatmapGrid'

export function CoverageHeatmapContainer({ courseId }: { courseId: string }) {
  const { data, loading, error, refetch } = useCoverageHeatmap(courseId)
  if (loading) return <HeatmapSkeleton />
  if (error) return <ErrorState message={error} onRetry={refetch} />
  return <CoverageHeatmapGrid matrix={data!.matrix} summary={data!.summary} />
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E06/E06-S02.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const BASE = process.env.BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3000'

test('Acceptance: heatmap grid renders 18 system rows', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/coverage?course_id=${process.env.TEST_COURSE_ID}`)
  const rows = page.locator('[data-testid="heatmap-row"]')
  await expect(rows).toHaveCount(18)
})

test('Acceptance: each row has 6 Bloom columns', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/coverage?course_id=${process.env.TEST_COURSE_ID}`)
  const firstRow = page.locator('[data-testid="heatmap-row"]').first()
  const cells = firstRow.locator('[data-testid="heatmap-cell"]')
  await expect(cells).toHaveCount(6)
})

test('Acceptance: cells show correct color states', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/coverage?course_id=${process.env.TEST_COURSE_ID}`)
  // At least one cell should exist with a state class
  const stateCell = page.locator('[data-state]').first()
  await expect(stateCell).toBeVisible()
  const state = await stateCell.getAttribute('data-state')
  expect(['none', 'declared', 'delivered', 'confirmed']).toContain(state)
})

test('Acceptance: tooltip shows on hover', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/coverage?course_id=${process.env.TEST_COURSE_ID}`)
  const cell = page.locator('[data-testid="heatmap-cell"]').first()
  await cell.hover()
  const tooltip = page.locator('[role="tooltip"]')
  await expect(tooltip).toBeVisible()
})

test('Acceptance: summary bar shows coverage percentage', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/coverage?course_id=${process.env.TEST_COURSE_ID}`)
  const summary = page.locator('[data-testid="coverage-summary"]')
  await expect(summary).toContainText('%')
})

test('Negative: loading skeleton appears before data', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.route('**/api/coverage/heatmap*', (route) =>
    setTimeout(() => route.continue(), 2000)
  )
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/coverage?course_id=${process.env.TEST_COURSE_ID}`)
  const skeleton = page.locator('[data-testid="heatmap-skeleton"]')
  await expect(skeleton).toBeVisible()
})
```
